note: Pictures that ship with the site (public/images/<id>.webp, made by npm run images from images/<id>.*) for questions that already live in the database. Each time the server sees this file change, it attaches every picture listed here to its question, but only if that question has no picture yet: a picture set in the builder is never replaced.
